But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn.

translations.web: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.
translations.bsb: “Not everyone can accept this word,” He replied, “but only those to whom it has been given.
translations.kjv: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
translations.asv: But he said unto them, Not all men can receive this saying, but they to whom it is given.
